environment_contract.mock_policy: Mocks do not satisfy P05 Exit Conditions

cases.name: migration-and-schema
cases.precondition: empty MySQL 8.x database
cases.oracle: P05 migration applies once, required constraints/indexes exist, second application is rejected or recorded safely

cases.name: create-read-update-delete-real-api
cases.precondition: migrated MySQL, Redis healthy, platformapi running
cases.oracle: create/read/update/delete persists in MySQL with workspace isolation and version increments

cases.name: custom-code-conflict
cases.precondition: workspace has an existing active code
cases.oracle: invalid codes are rejected and same-host code uniqueness conflict returns deterministic conflict semantics

cases.name: risk-fingerprint-target-set
cases.precondition: link contains primary, routing and A/B destinations
cases.oracle: fingerprint is deterministic and includes every reachable normalized target without hostname-policy divergence

cases.name: target-mutation-invalidates-risk
cases.precondition: exact-current fingerprint has allow decision
cases.oracle: editing primary/routing/A-B target produces a different fingerprint and prior allow no longer authorizes redirect

cases.name: allow-redirect
cases.precondition: exact-current Redis risk decision is allow
cases.oracle: redirectengine returns configured redirect status and Location only after exact-current allow

cases.name: review-fails-closed
cases.precondition: exact-current Redis risk decision is review
cases.oracle: user destination is not exposed; redirectengine returns GoJet safety-surface response

cases.name: block-fails-closed
cases.precondition: exact-current Redis risk decision is block
cases.oracle: user destination is not exposed; blocked safety response is returned

cases.name: missing-malformed-stale-fail-closed
cases.precondition: risk decision is independently missing, malformed and stale
cases.oracle: all three conditions refuse destination access and enter the appropriate safety/unavailable response

cases.name: risk-precedes-routing-ab-utm-access
cases.precondition: link has routing, A/B, UTM, password and lifecycle access controls
cases.oracle: risk non-allow is handled before password/access; after allow the password challenge is no-store/noindex and target-free, verifier/plaintext never leave internal persistence, wrong guesses fail closed and rate-limit, correct password alone may proceed to lifecycle claim, password-only mutations preserve the risk fingerprint, and restore recovers password state without verifier disclosure

cases.name: routing-and-ab-after-allow
cases.precondition: risk allow exists for exact target set
cases.oracle: routing and weighted A/B resolve only among fingerprinted targets and UTM is applied after target selection

cases.name: rbac-server-authority
cases.precondition: viewer/read-only actor attempts mutation and cross-workspace access
cases.oracle: server denies mutations/cross-workspace access independent of frontend visibility

cases.name: optimistic-concurrency-conflict
cases.precondition: two writers hold the same link version
cases.oracle: first update succeeds, stale writer receives conflict and cannot overwrite silently

cases.name: history-restore-audit
cases.precondition: link has multiple versions
cases.oracle: history records actor/reason/version; restore creates a new version and re-invalidates risk when target set changes

cases.name: list-search-filter-bulk-export
cases.precondition: workspace has varied link fixtures persisted through API
cases.oracle: list/count/search/filter/bulk state/export return workspace-scoped deterministic results

cases.name: redirect-status-and-disabled-states
cases.precondition: active, paused, expired, click-limited and deleted links exist
cases.oracle: active exact-allow redirects with configured status; disabled states do not reach destination and return registered status semantics

cases.name: workspace-links-browser-flow
cases.precondition: platformapi/redirectengine and Workspace static app are running against real MySQL/Redis data
cases.oracle: list/search/filter/create/detail/edit/history flow completes without console/page errors or reload regressions; Workspace can create, replace and clear password protection while never echoing plaintext/verifier, and password-only mutations preserve the destination-risk fingerprint

cases.name: mobile-and-accessibility-browser-flow
cases.precondition: real Workspace Links flow available
cases.oracle: canonical mobile viewport has no root overflow/clipped required text and applicable focus/keyboard/name-role-value contracts pass

cases.name: safety-and-password-surface-browser
cases.precondition: review/block/missing decisions and an exact-allow password-protected link are configured independently
cases.oracle: review/block/missing browser flows stay on target-free GoJet safety surfaces with no bypass; exact-allow password protection renders an accessible no-store/noindex challenge, rejects wrong password without target disclosure, redirects only after the current password is accepted, and disappears after owner-authorized password clearing

cases.name: p00-p04-regression-and-evidence-index
cases.precondition: P05 candidate implementation complete
cases.oracle: P00-P04 affected regressions remain green and P05 evidence index is exact-head complete
